title: Provenance Is Future Memory

rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: Provenance Is Future Memory: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: Provenance is future memory when it preserves a transparent chain of identity, custody, intervention, attribution, evidence, uncertainty, and rights—not merely a prestigious prior owner.

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · IDENTITY — Is this the same object?. Record stable identifier, components, marks, labels, measurements, materials, images, condition, alterations, and comparison basis; note uncertainty and separated parts.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping is this the same object? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · CHAIN — Can each custody event be evidenced?. Attach acquisition, gift, inheritance, loan, sale, deposit, return, location, responsible party, document, date, and restriction without inventing missing links.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can each custody event be evidenced? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · INTERVENE — What changed the object or record?. Log repair, conservation, cleaning, alteration, reframing, digitization, renaming, reattribution, exhibition, reproduction, and metadata correction.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what changed the object or record? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CLAIM — How confident is the story?. Label verified fact, physical observation, attributed conclusion, participant account, inference, disputed statement, and unresolved gap; retain earlier versions and correction history.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how confident is the story? within Provenance Is Future Memory.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields
